newsitem.title: USA: Calif. treasurer tours Asia for investments.
newsitem.headline: Calif. treasurer tours Asia for investments.

text.p: California's state Treasurer and representatives from public pension funds with combined assets of $234 billion have begun an eight-day Asia tour, state officials said Monday.

The purpose of the trip was to identify investment opportunities for California pension funds and introduce California pension fund officials to Asian venture capitalists looking for investment opportunities in the state, a spokesman for California Treasurer Matt Fong said.

Fong's delegation included officials with the California Public Employees' Retirement System, the State Teachers Retirement System, the Los Angeles City Employees Retirement System, the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pension System, the San Diego County Employee Retirement Association, and the Connecticut's Combined Investment Fund.
Fong hosted a financial summit in Hong Kong earlier Monday, his office said. The delegation also planned to visit China, Singapore and Taiwan through January 19.
